gallery.$description: Gallery: panes side by side, one in view (or several), moved by the buttons at the sides, the dots under them, a swipe or the keys; a slideshow when told.

gap.$description: Between panes shown side by side.

nav-inset.$description: From a side of the gallery to the button over it.

bar-inset.$description: From the bottom of the gallery to the bar with the dots and the slideshow button.

indicator-gap.$description: Between the dots, and between them and the slideshow button.

frame.$description: The viewport the panes slide in: `focus` when the keys have it, `swipeable` when a drag moves it, `dragging` while one does.

item.$description: A pane: `current` when it is the one in view.

caption.$description: The band over the bottom of a pane with its texts.

nav.$description: The previous and next buttons over the sides: `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`, `disabled` at an end without `loop`.

arrow.$description: The glyph in a nav button: `icon` its shape (`previous`, `next`), `bg` its colour.

bar.$description: The bar over the bottom with the dots and the slideshow button.

dot.$description: A dot of the indicator, one per pane: `current` for the pane in view, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`.

play-glyph.$description: The glyph in the slideshow button: `icon` its shape (a pause mark while `playing`), `bg` its colour.
